title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (laravel) — review required
description: In laravel, DB::raws*([^)]*(?:"[^"n]*$|.s*$) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via parameter bindings.
applicability: laravel data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
